calculation: usage.total_tokens when present; otherwise usage.input_tokens + usage.output_tokens
cached_input_rule: cached_input_tokens is a subset of input_tokens and is not added again
admission: multi_agent is disabled, exactly one thread.started and one turn.completed are required, and both operands must be non-negative integers when total_tokens is absent
repair_basis: r3 observed terminal usage without total_tokens before any valid baseline measurement; the Responses usage definition identifies total as input plus output
